history.summary: Freehold 2017 shoebox 1BR in Geylang/Paya Lebar fringe. Algo flags it cheap-for-age (age_adj -18.2%) but the asking PSF of ~$1,582 sits ABOVE the project's real ~$1,499 12-month average, so the headline cheapness is age-relative accounting, not an actual price discount.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $818k at $1,582 psf for a 517 sqft 1BR. Web-verified Guillemard Suites 12-month transactions average ~$1,499 psf (range $1,366-$1,760), so this unit is priced ~5% ABOVE the project average, not below it. 5yr URA CAGR is roughly flat (-0.37% over 42 txns) and the +3.8% premium-vs-cohort (7 txns) confirms no value edge. D14 sits in RCR (~+3.5% realized fwd), modestly favorable, and freehold + Paya Lebar/Dakota MRT access supports steady ~5% gross rental demand. But paying above-market PSF for a small Geylang-fringe shoebox with flat 5yr capital history is a hold, not a buy.

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 5yr URA CAGR essentially flat (-0.37% on 42 txns) - decent sample, so the no-growth read is reliable. Trailing appreciation carries ~0 forward weight; story here is yield/location, not capital growth.
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Strong rental backbone (431 lifetime rental txns, ~$5.6-5.7 psf/month). At $818k a market rent of ~$2,800-3,000 implies ~4.1-4.4% gross - reasonable but not a standout for the entry price.
